transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I can’t shake the feeling that I’ve ruined things for everyone. I fell behind at work, and I lost control of the apartment situation, and it just feels like I deserve whatever bad thing happens next.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a year and two months, I think. It started after the pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller apartment. My routines kind of fell apart after that.
Over this past year, have you been feeling down, depressed, or empty most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah. Most days I wake up feeling flat and heavy, sad for no clear reason. Things I used to enjoy—putting on a record, cooking, messing with electronics—don’t really reach me anymore.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, euphoric, or wired, needing much less sleep than usual?
I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed stretches where I felt especially energized or needed a lot less sleep.
Before this past year and two months, had you ever experienced another period in your life where you felt this depressed and down?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time that was like this.
How has your sleep been during this past year?
It’s been pretty bad. I lie awake for hours listening to noises in the apartment, and then when I do fall asleep, I’m up before dawn already tense and exhausted—like I never really shut down.
During this difficult time, have you had thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of ending your life?
I don’t have a plan to hurt myself. But sometimes I think it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up, and nobody had to deal with me anymore.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight during this time?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any clear change in my appetite or weight.
